STG.Title: Tavern
STG.NoGM: No GM is online. The tables need a GM, you can still watch.
STG.Welcome: Pull up a chair. Open a table and play against a friend or one of the regulars.

tictactoe.name: Tic-tac-toe
tictactoe.guide: Hearken! Upon a board of nine fields ye set your marks in turn, and the cross goeth first. Whoso setteth three marks in a row, be it across, down or aslant, is the victor. Be every field filled and no row complete, ye share the honour.

fourinarow.name: Four in a row
fourinarow.guide: Mark well: cast thy disc into a column of thy choosing, and it falleth unto the lowest free place. Whoso first joineth four discs of their colour in a line, upright, flat or aslant, winneth the day. Red beginneth.

morris.name: Nine men's morris
morris.guide: Each of ye hath nine men. Place them upon the points in turn, then move them along the lines to a free neighbour. Who setteth three in a row hath built a mill and may take a man of the foe, yet none from a closed mill whilst others stand free. With but three men left, thy men may leap to any free point. Whoso hath fewer than three men, or cannot move, is beaten.

matches.name: The matchstick game
matches.guide: Fifteen matches lie upon the board. Each in turn taketh one, two or three, as they see fit. Whoso must take the last match hath lost, and the whole tavern shall mock them.

pig.name: Pig
pig.guide: Cast the die as oft as thy courage alloweth and gather its pips. Hold, and thy gathering is safe in thy purse. Yet should the die show but a single eye, all thou gathered this turn is lost. Whoso first reacheth the goal winneth.

ship.name: Ship, captain and crew
ship.guide: Thou hast three throws of five dice. First thou needest a six for the ship, then a five for the captain, then a four for the crew, and in this order alone. Once all are aboard, the two dice remaining are thy cargo: cast them anew whilst throws remain, or drop anchor and keep it. Without a crew thou bringest home nought. The richest cargo winneth.

liars.name: Liar's dice
liars.guide: Each of ye shaketh five dice beneath a cup and looketh only upon their own. In turn ye wager how many dice of one face lie upon the whole board, ever higher than the wager before: more dice, or as many of a greater face. Or cry "Liar!" Then all cups are lifted. Should the wager hold, the accuser loseth a die, else the liar. Who loseth their last die leaveth the game, the last with dice in hand is victor.

twentyone.name: Twenty-one
twentyone.guide: Ye play against the house, and Greta the innkeeper dealeth. Draw a card, or stand content with what thou holdest. Come nigher to one and twenty than the house, yet never beyond, and thou winnest. Aces count one or eleven, the courtly cards ten. The house must draw unto seventeen.
